question: In ADVENTUREWORKS, which pairs of productmodelid share the most class values in common? Give me the top 10 pairs.
sql: SELECT a.productmodelid AS entity_a, b.productmodelid AS entity_b, COUNT(*) AS shared_cnt FROM ADVENTUREWORKS.PRODUCT a JOIN ADVENTUREWORKS.PRODUCT b ON a.class = b.class AND a.productmodelid < b.productmodelid GROUP BY a.productmodelid, b.productmodelid ORDER BY shared_cnt DESC LIMIT 10;

question: In ADVENTUREWORKS, how concentrated is listprice within each class? Report the top-decile share and give me the 10 most concentrated.
sql: WITH q AS ( SELECT class AS c, listprice AS v, NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY class ORDER BY listprice DESC) AS decile FROM ADVENTUREWORKS.PRODUCT WHERE listprice IS NOT NULL ) SELECT c, SUM(CASE WHEN decile = 1 THEN v ELSE 0 END) AS top_decile_amt, SUM(v) AS total_amt, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN decile = 1 THEN v ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(SUM(v), 0) AS concentration FROM q GROUP BY c ORDER BY concentration DESC LIMIT 10;
